summary: Test whether row-freeness defects admit additive small-cluster contributions under the random-prefix polymer activity bound.
Use RSK standard-monomial normal forms to determine whether adversarial tops have distinct leading terms and hence local independence.
Study local independence through the nondegeneracy of bordered-minor overlap matrices suggested by Slater determinants.
Replace a failed global equivalent family by patchwise functional gauges and test whether the patches can be glued.
Use ideal-union connecting maps to choose compatible confined-piece lifts whose gluing is row-free.
Develop the explicit PHP-basis PC lift while distinguishing functional-axiom identities from those valid on the weak base.
Seek chessboard coboundary expansion robust to correlated W_RS exclusions, beyond the independent-exclusion union bound.
Analyze warning cascades under shared-value correlations to decide whether forced-zero cores percolate.
Identify the bootstrap-percolation threshold for PC forcing on the actual allowed-set quotient rather than the truncated matching model.
Test whether replica-symmetric connectivity yields the required top-lift property, beyond the observation that the excluded set is sparse.
Find a code-distance analogue controlling all shifted row directions, overcoming the insufficiency of single-direction freeness.
Apply two-query code dimension bounds to relation-rich squared-form families and identify the sparse-relation regime left uncovered.
Seek a Laman-type counting criterion for relation configurations carrying non-local syzygies.
Prove a relative Fröberg-type Hilbert-series identity for random-prefix families, retaining its limits for adversarial forms.
Turn low-dimensional erasure correctability into a higher-degree cleaning argument for per-block transversality.
Construct local algebraic Morse matchings whose critical first cells remain member-supported outside the free regime.
Develop a graded cluster expansion where large connected relation groups first contribute at proportionally high degree.
Classify small-weight dual projective-code words to enumerate non-local member dependencies and test their absorption.
Use finite-field divisibility to classify signed configurations with constant determinantal zero counts and their sparse-family realizability.
Use form-value grid surjectivity to test whether tensor dependencies can lift from general-position clauses on the Boolean base.
Translate small polymer activities into degreewise algebraic control of falls, rather than assuming Hilbert dimensions add like measures.
Prove or refute the member-ring graded Dade margin, including special positions and genuine Hilbert-series positivity.
Seek a Horace interpolation theorem for the truncated member-span algebra, accounting for cube-killing and defective configurations.
Establish a costed subspace-spread dichotomy: pin common kernels or prove interpolation for spread member spans.
Bound concentration of member ideals on small GL orbits to prove random-form directness via an orbit-weighted intersection criterion.
Construct low-degree design multipliers vanishing only on excluded points within the base design's support, beyond the capacity baseline.
Glue one functional representable on each block's allowed set, bypassing the union of excluded sets through compatible local designs.
